name: Surf forecast verification
what: Collects the 7-day swell forecast for three Portuguese spots from three wave models, and yesterday's analysis; verifies forecasts against analysis.
cost: 0 EUR · public repo, Open-Meteo, no keys

name: Model release watch
what: Runs the Quaesitor harness against the current model aliases on two packs, indexes the reports with fingerprints and cost, pushes the data file.
schedule: launchd on the author's machine · 1st of the month 03:00 · eu.bsandova.model-watch

name: Site deploy
what: Every push to main runs build.sh (stamps style.css with the commit) and deploys the repository as Cloudflare Worker static assets on bsandova.com; the surf cron's data commit triggers it too.
schedule: GitHub Actions on push to main · wrangler deploy

name: cutover · tests
what: The package behind How to prove a cutover: ruff and pytest on Python 3.10–3.13 on every push; PyPI release on tag.
